<h1>Trigs</h1>

The trig view is the default view for every sequencer. It is the central editing surface: here you write which steps fire, set percentage chance, configure conditional and sustain trigs, and set per-row play modes.

<nav class="docs-contents" aria-label="On this page"><b>On this page:</b> <a href="#what-you-see">What You See</a><span class="sep" aria-hidden="true"> · </span><a href="#trig-status-colours">Trig Status Colours</a><span class="sep" aria-hidden="true"> · </span><a href="#editing-steps-steps-116">Editing Steps (Steps 1–16)</a><span class="sep" aria-hidden="true"> · </span><a href="#sustain-sus_start--sus_hold">Sustain (SUS_START / SUS_HOLD)</a><span class="sep" aria-hidden="true"> · </span><a href="#row-mode-column-9-on-lhs">Row Mode (Column 9 on LHS)</a><span class="sep" aria-hidden="true"> · </span><a href="#reset-and-randomise-shift--mute--shift--solo">Reset and Randomise (SHIFT + MUTE / SHIFT + SOLO)</a></nav>

## What You See

The grid is 8 rows × 16 steps. Each Launchpad shows half the grid:

- **LP LHS** (LP1 for P1, LP3 for P2): columns 1–8 = steps 1–8. Column 9 (rightmost LP button on each row) = row mode toggle.
- **LP RHS** (LP2 for P1, LP4 for P2): columns 1–8 = steps 9–16.

Rows are numbered **1 at the bottom of the pad up to 8 at the top**. The manual counts them that way everywhere, so row 1 is always the bottom row you are looking at, whichever view you are in.

The trig view is per-sequencer: selecting a different sequencer (top-bar buttons) switches your own two pads to that sequencer's trig grid. The other player's pads do not move, and nothing you hear changes: selection decides what you are looking at and editing, not what plays.

---

## Trig Status Colours

Each step in the grid shows one of the following states:

| Status | Colour | Code | Description |
|--------|--------|------|-------------|
| OFF | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#000000;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Unlit | 0 | Step is silent |
| ON | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#0fa586;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Teal-green | 1 | Step fires unconditionally on every pass |
| PERCENTAGE_CHANCE | <span style="display:inline-flex;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#11a40e"></span><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#30ec15"></span><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#81ff55"></span><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#9efe9e"></span></span>Green (4 shades) | 2 | Fires at a per-sequencer percentage-chance threshold |
| TRIGMUTE | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#967562;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Tan | 3 | Step is overridden to silence (will not fire) |
| MOD1 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#e3aed7;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Pale pink | 4 | Fires every other bar (even bars 0, 2, 4 … 14) |
| MOD2 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#e7d8fd;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Pale lilac | 5 | Fires every other bar (odd bars 1, 3, 5 … 15) |
| MOD4 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#77c5ff;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Light blue | 6 | Fires on bars 3, 7, 11, 15 (every 4th bar) |
| MOD8 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#609dff;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Mid blue | 7 | Fires on bars 7 and 15 (every 8th bar) |
| MOD16 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#013ac0;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Deep blue | 8 | Fires on bar 15 only (once per 16-bar cycle) |
| INVMOD4 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#c29d0d;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Mustard | 9 | Fires on all bars **except** 3, 7, 11, 15 |
| INVMOD8 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#822c08;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Dark orange-brown | 10 | Fires on all bars **except** 7 and 15 |
| INVMOD16 | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#820610;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Dark red | 11 | Fires on all bars **except** 15 |
| SUS_START | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#afc709;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Yellow-green | 12 | First step of a sustained note |
| SUS_HOLD | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#435d7c;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Slate grey | 13 | Middle/end steps of a sustained note |

The mod divisions read as a run: pink, lilac, then three deepening blues.
Their inverses read as a warm run: mustard, dark orange, dark red.

> The bar counter runs 0–15 within the 16-bar cycle. MOD and INVMOD conditions are evaluated against the current bar number at the moment the step plays.

### Percentage-Chance shading

PERCENTAGE_CHANCE steps change colour based on the per-sequencer chance threshold (set via the LC knobs (see [LaunchControl knobs and faders](/documentation/MSEQ/lc-knobs))):

| Chance value | Appearance |
|-------------|------------|
| 0% | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#967562;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Looks like TRIGMUTE (never fires) |
| 1–12% | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#11a40e;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Deepest green |
| 13–25% | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#30ec15;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Green |
| 26–65% | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#81ff55;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Light green |
| 66–95% | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#9efe9e;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Palest green |
| 96–100% | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#0fa586;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Looks like ON (essentially always fires) |

The deeper the green, the less likely the step is to fire.

### Euclidean overlay

When a Euclidean trig pattern is active on a row, OFF steps that fall on Euclidean trig positions change colour: bright magenta on the selected row, dim magenta on every other row. See [Euclidean trigs](/documentation/MSEQ/euclidean) for full Euclidean semantics.

### Sequencer-muted overlay

When the sequencer's sequencer mute state is `MUTED` or any autodrop variant, the frontend overlays a dark red on all active trig positions to signal that output is suppressed.

## Editing Steps (Steps 1–16)

Press any step pad in columns 1–8 (LHS for steps 1–8, RHS for steps 9–16). The result depends on the LC modifier held at the moment of the press:

| LC modifier | Action |
|-------------|--------|
| *(none)* | **Toggle <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#000000;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>OFF ↔ <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#0fa586;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>ON**. If step is <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#967562;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>TRIGMUTE: → ON. If step is a sustain step: break the sustain at this step, then → ON. |
| **SHIFT** | **<span style="display:inline-flex;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#11a40e"></span><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#30ec15"></span><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#81ff55"></span><span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#9efe9e"></span></span>PERCENTAGE_CHANCE**. If step is <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#000000;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>OFF: → PERCENTAGE_CHANCE. If step is sustain: break sustain → PERCENTAGE_CHANCE. From any other state: → OFF. |
| **MUTE** | **<span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#967562;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>TRIGMUTE**. If step is <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#000000;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>OFF or <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#0fa586;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>ON: → TRIGMUTE. If step is sustain: break sustain → TRIGMUTE. From TRIGMUTE or any mod state: → OFF. |
| **SOLO** | **Sustain**: set start / end markers (see "Sustain" below). |
| **REC ARM** | **Cycle mod division**: <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#000000;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>OFF → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#e3aed7;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD1 → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#e7d8fd;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD2 → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#77c5ff;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD4 → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#609dff;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD8 → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#013ac0;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD16 → OFF. If currently INVMOD: convert back to the corresponding MOD. If sustain: break sustain → MOD1. |
| **8A** | **Inverse mod**: if step is <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#000000;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>OFF/<span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#0fa586;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>ON/<span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#e3aed7;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD1/<span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#e7d8fd;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD2/<span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#77c5ff;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD4 → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#c29d0d;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>INVMOD4; <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#609dff;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD8 → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#822c08;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>INVMOD8; <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#013ac0;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>MOD16 → <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#820610;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>INVMOD16. If already INVMOD: convert to corresponding MOD (INVMOD4→MOD4, INVMOD8→MOD8, INVMOD16→MOD16). If sustain: break sustain → INVMOD4. |
| **8B** | **Euclidean overlay**: the pressed step becomes the Euclidean rotation point. If this row already has Euclidean enabled at this step, toggle off and clear. See [Euclidean trigs](/documentation/MSEQ/euclidean). |

## Sustain (SUS_START / SUS_HOLD)

Sustain trigs hold a MIDI note across multiple steps instead of retriggering it. A sustain region is defined by two SOLO+press gestures:

1. **First press** (SOLO held): sets the sustain start step. Nothing is written yet; MSEQ waits for the end marker.
2. **Second press** (SOLO held): sets the sustain end step. MSEQ immediately writes:
   - SUS_START at the start step.
   - SUS_HOLD at every step between start and end (inclusive, wrapping around if end < start).

<img src="/assets/mseq/sustain-one-note.png" alt="One sustain region on the bottom row: a yellow-green start pad labelled C3, followed by three slate hold pads" style="display:block;margin-inline:auto">

*One sustain region, four steps long. The yellow-green pad is the step you
pressed first and the slate pads behind it are that same note still sounding.*

The sustain region wraps across bar boundaries: if start = 14 and end = 3, steps 14→16 and 1→3 all become SUS_HOLD.

**Breaking a sustain**: pressing any step inside an existing sustain region with any modifier clears the sustain back to individual steps before applying the new status.

## Row Mode (Column 9 on LHS)

The rightmost button on each row of the LP LHS sets the **row play mode** for that row. The action depends on the LC modifier held:

| LC modifier | Action |
|-------------|--------|
| *(none)* | **Instant toggle MUTED ↔ UNMUTED** |
| **SHIFT** | **Row autodrop**: cue an autodrop for this row (row will auto-unmute after the cycle) |
| **MUTE** | **Toggle DRONE**: if the row is muted, enter Drone immediately; if in Drone range: → Muted; if unmuted: → Drone |
| **SOLO** | **Toggle LEGATO**: same logic as MUTE but targets Legato mode |
| **REC ARM** | **Cued transition at bar 0**: cues unmute, or cues the current mode to mute at next 16-bar boundary |
| **MUTE + REC ARM** | **Cued DRONE**: cue the row to enter Drone mode at next bar 0 |
| **SOLO + REC ARM** | **Cued LEGATO**: cue the row to enter Legato mode at next bar 0 |

Row cues land at **bar 0 of the 16-bar cycle only**, so one set early in a cycle
waits a while. Repeating the gesture that set a cue cancels it and leaves the
row playing as it already was, which is the quick way out if you change your
mind. Sequencer mutes are the more immediate layer: theirs also get a chance at
bar 8 (see [Mutes and row states](/documentation/MSEQ/mutes)).

**Row play modes:** column 9 is a round button, so its colours are shown round
here to separate them from the square step pads above.

| Row state | Button | Behaviour |
|-----------|--------|-----------|
| Muted | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#000000;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Unlit | Row is silent; no notes fire |
| Cued to unmute | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#435d7c;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Slate | Muted, with an unmute waiting for the next boundary |
| Unmuted | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#d0914a;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Orange | Normal step playback |
| Drone | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#0fa586;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Teal-green | A single note fires immediately on entering Drone and is held until Drone exits |
| Legato | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#428fff;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Blue | Steps play with extended duty: notes connect into each other |
| Unmuted with arp | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#b8268c;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Magenta | Unmuted, with an arp running on the row |
| Autodropped in | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#7a44bc;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Purple | Brought in by an autodrop for the cycle |
| Autodropped out | <span style="display:inline-block;inline-size:.95em;block-size:.95em;background:#435d7c;border:solid 1px rgba(219,219,219,0.5);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.12em;margin-inline-end:.55em"></span>Slate | Dropped out by an autodrop, waiting to return |

A row that is changing state flashes between the two colours rather than showing
a third one. A row that is muted and cued to Drone flashes slate and teal-green,
and a row that is unmuted and cued to mute flashes orange and unlit.

See [Mutes and row states](/documentation/MSEQ/mutes) for the full cued-state transition table and LED colours on the LP for row mute states.

> **Note on Sequencer 13 / TR-8, row 1 (the bottom row), column 9 (LHS only):** This position is the Boom-TSK toggle. Pressing it drops the whole kit to a fixed kick-and-offbeat-hat pattern, muting every other TR-8 row on both the main and alt views; pressing it again silences it. This special case overrides the normal row-mode logic (see [Boom-tsk](/documentation/MSEQ/boom-tsk)).

## Reset and Randomise (SHIFT + MUTE / SHIFT + SOLO)

These global gestures affect the currently pressed **row** in the trig view:

| Gesture | Effect in trig view |
|---------|---------------------|
| **SHIFT + MUTE** (hold both, then press a step in any column) | Reset the entire trig row to all-OFF. Also clears any Euclidean pattern on that row. |
| **SHIFT + SOLO** (hold both, then press a step in any column) | Randomise the trig row with a random density pattern. |

These gestures are view-aware: the same gesture produces different effects in other views (step_velo, step_duty and so on). [Reset and randomise](/documentation/MSEQ/reset) has the full matrix.
